## Packages

```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse,tidymodels,here,gt)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
phones <- here("data/smartphone_cleaned_v5.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_type=FALSE)
```

## Data Cleaning

```{r}
phones_clean <- phones |>
  mutate(
    fast_charging = if_else(fast_charging_available == 0, 0, fast_charging),
    log_price = log(price),
    brand_group = fct_lump_n(brand_name, n=5),
    has_5g = factor(has_5g),
    has_nfc = factor(has_nfc)
  ) |>
  select(
    log_price, processor_speed, ram_capacity, internal_memory, refresh_rate, fast_charging, primary_camera_rear, primary_camera_front, rating, battery_capacity, has_5g, has_nfc, brand_group
  ) |>
  na.omit()
```

```{r}
nrow(phones_clean)
levels(phones_clean$brand_group)
```

## Split Data

```{r}
set.seed(41352)
phone_split <- phones_clean |> initial_split(prop=0.75)
phone_training <- phone_split |> training()
phone_test <- phone_split |> testing()
```

## Prepocessing recipe

```{r}
phone_recipe <- recipe(log_price ~ ., data = phone_training) |>
  step_normalize(processor_speed, ram_capacity, internal_memory, refresh_rate, fast_charging, primary_camera_rear, primary_camera_front) |>
  step_pca(processor_speed, ram_capacity, internal_memory, refresh_rate, fast_charging, primary_camera_rear, primary_camera_front, threshold = 0.7, id = "pca") |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_zv(all_predictors())
```

## Prep recipe

```{r}
phone_prep <- phone_recipe |> prep()
```

## Variance explained

```{r}
var_tbl <- tidy(phone_prep, id = "pca", type = "variance")
```

```{r}
var_tbl |> 
  filter(terms %in% c("percent variance", "cumulative percent variance")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = terms, values_from = value) |>
  gt()
```

```{r}
var_tbl |>
  filter(terms == "percent variance") |>
  ggplot(aes(component, value)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Component", y = "% of variance", title = "Scree plot")
```

```{r}
bake(phone_prep, new_data = NULL) |>
  select(starts_with("PC")) |>
  ncol()
```
